title: Hiking Boots Charm
tooltips: That's one pretty big step for man.

levels.abilityStatusCurrent: Increases step height by 0.5 while equipped, letting you walk up one-block ledges without jumping.
levels.abilityStatusRelative: Restores the basic hiking effect, giving you +0.5 step height while equipped.

levels.abilityStatusCurrent: Increases step height by 1.0 while equipped, letting you walk up fence-height obstacles without jumping.
levels.abilityStatusRelative: Raises the charm to +1.0 step height while equipped.

levels.abilityStatusCurrent: Increases step height by 1.5 while equipped, letting you walk up two-block rises without jumping.
levels.abilityStatusRelative: Raises the charm to +1.5 step height while equipped.
